title: Outdoor Oven-Roasted German Pork Skewers
description: Grassy and juicy German dish featuring rice paper sheets and a Mediterranean twist, perfect for kids and outdoor gatherings.
instructions: Preheat the outdoor oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the pork pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread 3-4 pork pieces onto each rice paper sheet, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the skewers in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the pork is cooked through.
Remove the skewers from the oven and brush with the deglaze-fond.
Sprinkle chopped parsley over the skewers and serve hot.
Deglaze the baking sheet with a little water to remove the browned bits and serve the sauce on the side.
